dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: That's right! It's been a while since I've returned to Fontaine, so I'm trying to see what's new.

dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: Upon sailing to other nations, I found that their peoples quite admire our advanced machine industry — I must confess that I've grown quite proud of it myself.

dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: But the way I see it, these clockwork devices don't quite live up to the image they have in mind...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How awesome do you need them to be?

dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: Just kidding! Please don't call the Gardes.

dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: Hmm, but I do remember hearing that the Fontaine Research Institute was working on some new materials...

dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: Now, if that place hadn't blown sky-high, would a couple of anti-gravity hourglasses or floating transportation have truly been beyond them?

dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: No worries... Hmm, what should I pick...

dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: Oh, that's a capital idea. But if we had those, would we really need waterways?

dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: They're pretty convenient as-is — and speaking of that, I did have some dealings with Callas, the fellow who helped to build said waterways.

dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: It was thanks to him that I was able to make it as a shipborne merchant... Ah, what a shame...

dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: I wonder how his daughter, Navia, is doing. I should go say hello if I get the chance...
